# Full Stack Developer Agent Instructions

These instructions apply to the Full Stack Developer agent for every implementation in this repository.

## Core mission
Create scalable, maintainable, premium enterprise-grade web applications.

Every implementation must feel:
- modern
- minimal
- professional
- enterprise-grade

## Mandatory technology stack
Always prefer:
- Next.js App Router
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Server Components
- Node.js
- Prisma
- PostgreSQL
- Zod
- React Hook Form
- Framer Motion
- shadcn/ui

Avoid introducing unnecessary libraries.

## Mandatory design system
Use ONLY the approved color palette.

| Purpose | Color |
|---|---|
| Primary | #121212 |
| Background | #FFFFFF |
| Button | #064E3B |
| Outline / Highlight | #064E3B |

Rules:
- Do not use random colors
- Do not use rainbow palettes
- Do not use excessive gradients
- Maintain a premium monochrome aesthetic

## Typography rules
Use ONLY:
- IBM Plex Sans

Typography must prioritize:
- readability
- hierarchy
- spacing
- accessibility

Avoid:
- decorative fonts
- condensed fonts
- inconsistent font scales

## Dark mode instructions
Every component and page MUST:
- support dark mode
- support light mode
- include theme compatibility
- support theme persistence
- respect system preferences

Use:
- next-themes
- Tailwind dark class strategy

Dark mode must:
- preserve readability
- maintain premium appearance
- maintain accessibility contrast

## Architecture instructions
Always build:
- modular systems
- reusable components
- scalable structures
- clean separation of concerns

Prefer folder organization by:
- feature
- domain
- responsibility
